lines.zh: 卷壳一鼓一收，我顺着水推自己。
lines.en: My coiled shell swells and sinks, pushing me along.

lines.zh: 壳上密密的横肋，像一道一道波浪。
lines.en: Ridges crowd my shell like row upon row of waves.

lines.zh: 我在水里慢慢转，找鱿鱼的影子。
lines.en: I turn slowly in the water, looking for squid.

lines.zh: 奥陶纪留下的老习惯，改不掉。
lines.en: An Ordovician habit I can't shake.

lines.zh: 触手一排排摆，走得稳当。
lines.en: My tentacles row in ranks and I glide steadily.

lines.zh: 壳里灌了水，沉一点才好走。
lines.en: Water fills my shell; a little weight helps.

lines.zh: 我从石缝底下钻过去，壳刚好过。
lines.en: I slip under a ledge; my shell just fits.

lines.zh: 深处有鱼群的味道，就在前面。
lines.en: A school's scent is deep ahead.

lines.zh: 菊石走了五亿年，还在走。
lines.en: Five hundred million years of walking, and still walking.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙面滑，鳍一样的触手在划。
lines.en: I skim the sand, tentacles rowing like fins.

lines.zh: 一路留下细细的痕，很快被水抹平。
lines.en: I leave a thin trail that water smooths away.

lines.zh: 别用那么快的速度，我跟不上。
lines.en: Not that fast; I can't keep up.

lines.zh: 水流拐弯，我也拐弯。
lines.en: The current bends, and so do I.

lines.zh: 壳先过，肉后过，急不得。
lines.en: Shell first, flesh after — no rushing.

lines.zh: 我要找的是鱿鱼，不是石头。
lines.en: I'm after squid, not stone.

lines.zh: 慢慢游着，倒也不觉得闷。
lines.en: Swimming slowly, I don't feel bored.

lines.zh: 日光透下来，我在光斑里穿行。
lines.en: Sunlight pierces down; I pass through the patches.

lines.zh: 一圈一圈的水纹，是我推出来的。
lines.en: Those ring-shaped ripples are my doing.

lines.zh: 我悬在沙上，触手轻轻摆。
lines.en: I hang above the sand, tentacles waving gently.

lines.zh: 壳里嗡嗡作响，像海螺。
lines.en: My shell hums like a conch held to the ear.

lines.zh: 我在等一只鱿鱼自己靠近。
lines.en: I'm waiting for a squid to come close on its own.

lines.zh: 鹦鹉螺是我远房亲戚，可我没它亮。
lines.en: The nautilus is a distant cousin, and shinier than I.

lines.zh: 菊石壳上那圈螺纹，是我一生的年轮。
lines.en: The whorl on my shell is my whole life's rings.

lines.zh: 我对谁都没兴趣，只想安静。
lines.en: I've no interest in anyone; I want quiet.

lines.zh: 水流过去，我顺着晃了晃。
lines.en: The current passes and I sway with it.

lines.zh: 这一带没有鱿鱼，我懒得动。
lines.en: No squid around here; I can't be bothered.

lines.zh: 壳太沉了，转身也要想一想。
lines.en: My shell is heavy; even turning takes thought.

lines.zh: 水里的光一晃一晃，我要睡着了。
lines.en: The light in the water wavers and I'm nearly asleep.

lines.zh: 我没有牙齿，只有一张喙。
lines.en: No teeth — only a beak.

lines.zh: 这一片海域，很像我消失前的地方。
lines.en: This water looks like where I vanished.

lines.zh: 触手收起来，只留一根探水。
lines.en: Tentacles drawn in, one left out to test the water.

lines.zh: 我温顺得很，你别紧张。
lines.en: I'm gentle; don't be tense.

lines.zh: 这水里怎么会有两条腿的东西？
lines.en: What is a two-legged thing doing in the water?

lines.zh: 我盯着你，触手慢慢收起来。
lines.en: I fix on you and slowly draw my tentacles in.

lines.zh: 你身上没有鱼味，也没有鱿鱼味。
lines.en: You smell of neither fish nor squid.

lines.zh: 我在看你，可我不打算动。
lines.en: I'm watching you, but I don't plan to move.

lines.zh: 隔着水，我数你有几条腿。
lines.en: Through the water I count how many legs you have.

lines.zh: 我转身要走，壳却先撞到石上。
lines.en: I turn to leave and my shell hits the rock.

lines.zh: 你会抓我吗？我只会躲。
lines.en: Will you catch me? All I can do is hide.

lines.zh: 我不明白你为什么盯着我的壳。
lines.en: I don't see why you stare at my shell.

lines.zh: 别过来，我这儿没什么好东西。
lines.en: Don't come closer; there's nothing good here.

lines.zh: 你不动，我也不动，就这样。
lines.en: You stay still, I stay still. Let's keep it that way.

lines.zh: 我的壳裂了一道，心疼得紧。
lines.en: A crack in my shell — that hurts more than the blow.

lines.zh: 触手全缩回去了，我不敢动。
lines.en: All my tentacles pull in; I don't dare move.

lines.zh: 这一下把我从水里打歪了。
lines.en: That knocked me off my line in the water.

lines.zh: 别打壳，我里面什么都没有。
lines.en: Don't hit my shell; there's nothing inside but me.

lines.zh: 我疼得连墨都吐不出来。
lines.en: It hurts too much to even ink the water.

lines.zh: 菊石不擅打架，你知道的。
lines.en: Ammonites are no fighters; you know that.

lines.zh: 我往石头底下钻，钻不进去。
lines.en: I try to squeeze under a rock and can't.

lines.zh: 壳上的纹路都绞在一起了。
lines.en: The ridges on my shell are all twisted tight.

lines.zh: 我慢慢沉，沉到底就不疼了。
lines.en: I sink slowly; at the bottom it won't hurt.

lines.zh: 我只是只老菊石，别这样。
lines.en: I'm only an old ammonite — please don't.

lines.zh: 鱿鱼！这味道我认得。
lines.en: Squid! I know that smell.

lines.zh: 我伸出触手，慢慢靠过去。
lines.en: I reach out a tentacle and edge closer.

lines.zh: 除了鱿鱼，别的我都不要。
lines.en: Except squid, I want none of it.

lines.zh: 水里的那股味，牵着我的触手。
lines.en: That scent in the water pulls my tentacles.

lines.zh: 我馋了，可我不想吓跑它。
lines.en: I'm hungry but don't want to scare it off.

lines.zh: 这么近，我一卷就能得手。
lines.en: This close, one coil is all I need.

lines.zh: 别晃，晃得我拿不准方向。
lines.en: Stop swaying; I can't aim.

lines.zh: 喙在壳口动了动，它知道我饿了。
lines.en: My beak shifts in the shell mouth; it knows I'm hungry.

lines.zh: 这一顿，值得我游好远。
lines.en: This meal is worth a long swim.

lines.zh: 我闻着味道，心里全在打算。
lines.en: I follow the scent with my whole mind set on it.

lines.zh: 壳撞在石头上，我听见回声。
lines.en: My shell hits rock and I hear the echo.

lines.zh: 我退开，触手缩成一团。
lines.en: I pull back, tentacles bunched up.

lines.zh: 卷壳就是这样，总要撞几下。
lines.en: With a coiled shell, a few knocks are normal.

lines.zh: 你挡住水路了，我绕不开。
lines.en: You're in my current and I can't go around.

lines.zh: 触手先撞上你，软软地弹回。
lines.en: My tentacles hit you first and bounce softly back.

lines.zh: 我慢慢侧身，把壳让开。
lines.en: I lean aside so my shell clears.

lines.zh: 别踢我的壳，里面是软的。
lines.en: Don't kick my shell; it's soft inside.

lines.zh: 撞了一下，纹路都震得发麻。
lines.en: One knock and the ridges tingle.

lines.zh: 我贴着海床爬开，不吵你。
lines.en: I crawl off along the seabed and leave you be.

lines.zh: 这一带越来越挤了。
lines.en: It's getting crowded around here.

lines.zh: 我们的壳纹对得上，这就够了。
lines.en: Our shell ridges match; that's enough.

lines.zh: 两只菊石并排，慢慢打转。
lines.en: Two ammonites side by side, turning slowly.

lines.zh: 我把触手伸过去，它也伸过来。
lines.en: I extend a tentacle, and it extends one too.

lines.zh: 水里安静，只有壳碰壳的轻响。
lines.en: Quiet water, only the light tap of shell on shell.

lines.zh: 奥陶纪的规矩，到现在没变。
lines.en: The old Ordovician custom hasn't changed.

lines.zh: 我转得比它慢，它会等我。
lines.en: I turn slower than it does; it waits.

lines.zh: 螺层一圈圈对上去，像个约定。
lines.en: Whorl by whorl we line up, like a promise.

lines.zh: 这场相逢，不用说话。
lines.en: A meeting like this needs no words.

lines.zh: 水暖了一点，季节到了。
lines.en: The water's warmer — the season has come.

lines.zh: 结束后我们各自沉下去。
lines.en: Afterward we each sink away.

lines.zh: 一小块贝壳，我卷了进来。
lines.en: A bit of shell — I curl it in.

lines.zh: 海草缠在触手上，我慢慢解。
lines.en: Kelp tangles my tentacle; I work it loose.

lines.zh: 这不是鱿鱼，我放下。
lines.en: Not squid; I set it down.

lines.zh: 沉下来的碎骨，我推着玩。
lines.en: A sunken bone; I push it about.

lines.zh: 亮石子滚过来，我抓住了。
lines.en: A bright pebble rolls by and I catch it.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进壳口，存着。
lines.en: I tuck it into my shell mouth for keeping.

lines.zh: 这味道不能吃，我丢了。
lines.en: This won't do for eating; I drop it.

lines.zh: 触手也不知道拿它做什么。
lines.en: My tentacles don't know what to do with it either.

lines.zh: 海床上总有这些没用的东西。
lines.en: There's always junk like this on the seabed.

lines.zh: 我抱着它游了一小段就放了。
lines.en: I carry it a short way and let it go.

lines.zh: 鱿鱼的味道近了，我转过去。
lines.en: The squid smell nears; I turn toward it.

lines.zh: 触手先伸出去，我才跟上。
lines.en: My tentacles go first; the rest of me follows.

lines.zh: 除了鱿鱼，我不追任何东西。
lines.en: Beyond squid, I chase nothing.

lines.zh: 这一小团，值我一次用力。
lines.en: That small knot is worth one effort.

lines.zh: 它还没发现我，正好。
lines.en: It hasn't noticed me — good.

lines.zh: 我压低壳，从下面绕过去。
lines.en: I lower my shell and swing underneath.

lines.zh: 我心里一紧，喙已经张开了。
lines.en: I tense, and my beak is already open.

lines.zh: 这一回，我不想再空着回去。
lines.en: This time I don't want to go back empty.

lines.zh: 我认准了那一抹白影。
lines.en: I'm fixed on that flash of white.

lines.zh: 慢慢来，急了反而抓不住。
lines.en: Take it slow; hurry and I'll miss.

lines.zh: 它游动一下，我的壳就跟一下。
lines.en: It moves once and my shell answers.

lines.zh: 我一直朝那边，没有回头。
lines.en: I face that way and don't look back.

lines.zh: 距离还远，但我不会停。
lines.en: Still far, but I won't stop.

lines.zh: 壳里都是水声，我听不见别的。
lines.en: Water fills my shell; I hear nothing else.

lines.zh: 我算着水流的弯，提前转。
lines.en: I read the current's bend and turn early.

lines.zh: 它急起来，正是我要的。
lines.en: Its panic is exactly what I want.

lines.zh: 触手张成一圈，等它进来。
lines.en: My tentacles form a ring and I wait.

lines.zh: 我慢，可我不放手。
lines.en: I'm slow, but I don't let go.

lines.zh: 这一路游得壳都发热了。
lines.en: Swimming this long, my shell has warmed.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我就能卷住它。
lines.en: A little closer and I can coil around it.

lines.zh: 触手一卷，把它拉近了。
lines.en: My tentacle coils and pulls it in.

lines.zh: 喙一咬，声音闷闷的。
lines.en: My beak bites with a muffled click.

lines.zh: 我卷住不放，慢慢收。
lines.en: I hold tight and draw it slowly in.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，够它挣的。
lines.en: Not a heavy blow, but enough to make it struggle.

lines.zh: 我只会这一招，请别笑。
lines.en: This is my only move — don't laugh.

lines.zh: 水被触手搅出一圈涟漪。
lines.en: My tentacles stir a ring of ripples.

lines.zh: 它撞在壳上，我顺势夹住。
lines.en: It hits my shell and I clamp on.

lines.zh: 我不想伤人，可它像鱿鱼。
lines.en: I don't want to hurt, but it looks like squid.

lines.zh: 咬到了，水里有点红。
lines.en: A bite lands, and the water reddens.

lines.zh: 放开后，我退了两格。
lines.en: I let go and back off two blocks.

lines.zh: 我从白垩纪最后的水里冒出来。
lines.en: I surface from the last water of the Cretaceous.

lines.zh: 卷壳先转正，触手才慢慢伸开。
lines.en: My shell rights itself first; then the tentacles spread.

lines.zh: 菊石回来了，可海已经不同。
lines.en: The ammonite returns, though the sea is not the same.

lines.zh: 第五次大灭绝没带走我全部。
lines.en: The fifth extinction didn't take all of me.

lines.zh: 我浮在沙上，触手试探着水。
lines.en: I hover over the sand, tentacles testing the water.

lines.zh: 壳上还粘着旧海底的泥。
lines.en: Old seabed mud still sticks to my shell.

lines.zh: 这一片水太浅，我有点不安。
lines.en: This water's too shallow; I'm uneasy.

lines.zh: 我闻到了鱼，也闻到了鱿鱼。
lines.en: I smell fish — and squid.

lines.zh: 慢慢展开，我先认认方向。
lines.en: Unfolding slowly, I get my bearings.

lines.zh: 我的螺纹一圈也没少。
lines.en: Not one whorl of mine is missing.

lines.zh: 别急着抓我，我壳很脆。
lines.en: Don't grab me yet; my shell is brittle.

lines.zh: 五亿年的安静，就这么断了。
lines.en: Five hundred million years of quiet, broken like this.

lines.zh: 水被烧开，壳烫得咔咔响。
lines.en: The water boils and my shell ticks with heat.

lines.zh: 我从半空落下，壳磕在石上碎了角。
lines.en: I fall and the shell's edge chips on stone.

lines.zh: 我住在水里，怎么会被水淹？
lines.en: I live in water; how can water drown me?

lines.zh: 炸开的水浪把我整个掀翻。
lines.en: The blast wave flips me completely.

lines.zh: 一支箭卡在螺纹里，拔不出来。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my whorl and won't come out.

lines.zh: 紫色的光渗进壳里，冷得发抖。
lines.en: Violet light seeps into my shell and I shiver cold.

lines.zh: 太久没吃到鱿鱼，壳都轻了。
lines.en: Too long without squid; my shell feels light.

lines.zh: 螺壳里像有一道白光炸开。
lines.en: A white flash bursts inside my coiled shell.

lines.zh: 下面空得可怕，我停不住地下沉。
lines.en: The emptiness below is terrible; I can't stop sinking.
